description: श्री राम मंदिर निर्माण अयोध्या | RAM MANDIR AYODHYA CONSTRUCTION STATUS | AYODHYA RAM MANDIR NIRMAN  Friends, today we will give you complete information of the construction work of Ayodhya Shri Ram temple in this special video with the help of live illustration of the construction of the temple from the beginning to the present situation. for example:- 1. Brief information about the design of Ram temple 2. Period cycle of construction of Ram temple 3. Information about the company and artisans employed in the construction of Ram temple 4. Information about the surrender amount received for the construction of the temple 5. Information about the possible expenditure on temple construction 6. Where are the stones to be used in temple construction 7. Soil information obtained from excavation in construction 8. You will know how far the construction of the Ram temple has reached at present and 9. What will be the effect on the construction of the temple due to Corona  आपको बता दें की भगवान श्री राम के भव्य मंदिर निर्माण में लगभग 1100 करोड़ रुपये खर्च होने की संभावना है। तथा मंदिर निर्माण के लिए 2.77 एकड़ में 400 फीट लंबी और 250 फीट चौड़ाई में करीब 55 फीट गहरा गड्ढा खोदा गया है। वर्तमान में इस गड्ढे का लेवल समुद्र तल से 95 मीटर ऊंचा है।  बता दें की गर्भगृह के निकट हुई खुदाई में विशेष धातुओं के बर्तन मिलने के पश्चात जिला प्रशासन ने खुदाई रूकवा दी थी। जिसे की होली पश्चात पुनः आरंभ किया गया था।  यही नहीं अयोध्या राम जन्मभूमि की खोदाई में निकली मिट्टी भी श्रद्धालुओं के लिए पूज्य है।इस मिट्टी की बढ़ती डिमांड को देखते हुए अब तक देश के करीब 6000 श्रद्धालुओं की डिमांड पर उनके घरों तक यह मिट्टी पहुंचाई गई है। श्रीराम जन्मभूमि तीर्थ क्षेत्र ट्रस्ट ने इस मिट्टी का नामकरण कर दिया है और 'राम जन्मभूमि रजकण' का नाम दिया है। इस मिट्टी को कारसेवकपुरम में सावधानी और सुरक्षापूर्वक रखा गया है।  बता दें की 50 फीट गहरी राम मंदिर कि नींव को 44 परतों में भरने का काम तेजी से चल रहा है। तथा नींव की पहली परत को अप्रैल मध्य तक तैयार कर लिया गया है।  जानकारी के लिए बता दें की नींव की एक परत को सुखाने में 28 दिन का समय लग रहा है। श्री रामजन्मभूमि तीर्थ क्षेत्र ट्रस्ट का मानना है कि सितंबर महीने के खत्म होने तक नींव कि भराई का काम पूरा हो जाएगा।  अगस्त से पहले 20 फीट गहराई तक नींव ढाल लेने की योजना है। नींव के सामान्य रीति से पाटने के बजाए नवीन तकनीकी का प्रयोग किया जाएगा। भूमि को ठोस बनाने के लिए जो ईएफएम इंजीनियरिंग फिल्ड मटेरियल का प्रयोग हो रहा है उसमें सीमेंट, मोरंग, कंक्रीट, सिलिकॉन और फ्लाईऐश मिलाई गई है।  नींव भराई के लिए परिसर में ही मिक्सिंग प्लांट भी लगाया गया है। दो वाइब्रो रोलर ढलाई को कॉम्पेक्ट कर रहे हैं। तथा इस पूरे कम में 50 मजदूर और एक दर्जन से अधिक इंजीनियर लगे हैं।  अधिक जानकारी के लिए बता दें की नींव खुदाई में नीचे 40 फुट गहराई तक मलबा पाया गया था जिसे की हटाया गया। तथा 200 फिट के नीचे सरयू नदी की प्रचीन धारा भी मिली थी। इसी कारण से बन रहे भव्य मंदिर को अगले 1000 वर्षों तक कोई हानि ना हो इसलिए मंदिर की नींव अत्यधिक मजबूत बनाया जा रहा है।  वहीं दूसरी ओर जोधपुर के अरुणा माइंस द्वारा 350 घनफीट पत्थर से विशाल और सुंदर द्वार को तैयार किया गया है, तीन महीने पहले अयोध्या में 62 द्वारों में से एक द्वार बनाने का काम इन्हें मिला था। 21 कारीगरों ने 25 दिन में ही विशाल हिन्दू द्वार तैयार कर मंदिर ट्रस्ट प्रशासन को भेज दिया है. अयोध्या के पंचकोसी परिक्रमा मार्ग पर यह विशाल व सुंदर द्वार स्थापित होगा. इस द्वार पर राम, सीता, लक्ष्मण और हनुमान जी की फोटो लगेंगी।कारीगरों ने इस द्वार को बनाने में दिल से मेहनत की है. Later, in September, the temple's sculpture was accepted and in October the stones previously carved were shifted from the workshop to the temple. And in December 2020, the state-owned company Tata Engineers was selected to work on the construction of the Tata Tata Engineering and Tico. Let us tell you that the actual responsibility of the temple is on the Chandrakant Sompura of Ahmedabad. They have been taking care of the construction of the temple since 1986. The entire temple will be made of stones and and the temple will be of three levels. The height of each level will be 20 feet, the length of the temple will be 360 feet and the width will be 235 feet. The floor of the temple will be 16.5 feet high from the bottom. The height of the pebble of the Bhootal the 21st century. Not just that, a death test and the impact of the possible future earthquake have been observed at a depth of 200 feet below the earth. A thick cloud has been found below the earth at 200 feet, because at a distance of a few kilometers west of Garbhagri, the Saryu River is flowing. Since January 15, 2021, a volunteer nidhi has been started for the participation of the public, which was run by the World Hindu Mission and other organizations associated with them. It went on till February 17th and was also accepted online for the subscription to build a temple in which 5.5 billion rupees of fees have been collected so far, although this number is not the last and the last days Tata Sands has also submitted a crore coins in the past few days. Now if you want more information about temple construction then let me tell you that in the construction of Lord Ram's grand temple, there is a possibility of spending about 1100 crores. And the structure of the temple is 2.77 acres, 400 feet long and 250 feet wide, and almost 55 feet has been dug in an area of ​​75 hectares, 400 feet in length and 250 feet in width, and currently the level of this pit is 95 meters high above sea level. After the discovery of special dhatus in the nearby digging of Garbhagri, the district administration stopped the digging, which was restarted after Holi, this is not the only place that clay found in excavation of Ayodhya Shri Ram Janmabhoomi is also worshiped by the devotees. Despite the increasing demand for this soil, so far around 6,000 devotees have been demanded to bring this soil to their homes. Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Tirtha Kshet Land Trust has named this soil Raja Kadha from the name and Raja Kanh is also named. This soil has been kept in the service area with caution and safety. Tell me that to fill the 50 feet deep Ram temple seed into 44 layers is going on fast and the first layer of the seed was prepared by mid-April. For information, let me tell you that it takes about 28 days to Shri Ram Janmabhumi Tirthakshetra Trust believes that until the end of September, the filling will be complete. The plan is to take the mud to a depth of 20 feet before August. New techniques will be used instead of studying the normal way of the mud, which is the EFM Engineering faculty has come up with to strengthen the soil. The foundation of the new foundation is being built in the process of taking off from the earth. The new technology will be used instead of studying the similar method of the soil. The EMFM engineering filled material used to make the soil solid is 2 vibro roller beams are being compacted and 50 workers and more than a dozen engineers are engaged in this full work. For more information, tell that a rock below the mound was found at a depth of forty feet that was removed and the ancient canal of Saryo River was also found below 200 feet. Therefore, it is estimated the current structure of the temple should not be damaged for 1000 years. Therefore, the foundation of the temple is being too strong. The other part of the temple also become a boulder on the four sides of 6 acres, retaining walls to prevent the effect of the mucous will also be given inside the ground, and this work will be completed in the next three years On the other hand Aruna Mines of Jodhpur has set up a huge and beautiful door of 350 sq ft stones Three months before, Ayodhya had got the task of making a door out of 62 doors 25 days during 31 employees, a huge Hindu door has been set up and sent to the temple trust administration in the form of an important memorial hall at the start of the Aayodhya tradition. While constructing this temple in Sankara temple, the Indian military's government has been seen to be more strict than the Indian govt. A small stone in the front is from the Sankara period. A stone with the end of this period. Not only this, but Sita alia, located in Ashokvatika, Sri Lanka, will also be used in the Ram temple construction. Sita alia is the place where Mata Seeta was kept in captivity by Ravana. This stone was brought by Indian King of Sri Lanka, Melinda of the Covid-19 infection is increased, due to this the wait may be delayed. Let's say that the possibility of building a temple is taking effect, it will be completed in 30 months, it is already a challenge to complete the construction of the temple in this period. And now due to the Corona crisis, an increase in construction material will also be taken from, due to the corona crisis, the number of construction supplies from workers to faraway places is almost half. The announcement of the construction period of the temple was made on 5th August last year. At the time, when PM Narendra Modi started construction of the temple with land worship, then the construction of the temple was announced to be completed in 49 months This year since 15th January, the construction process of the temple has increased dramatically. Since the last week only, the L.N.T project organization was supposed to increase the number of workers by 50% in the amount of the needle work and increase it to 200. Due to the pandemic crisis, this plan is stunted. Thanks to god not only 50 workers are still involved in the construction of temples but also they are free from any kind of infection. Experts believe that if the number of the workers does not increase too quickly in number of workers, then by the end of next month of August, the filling of the vault is difficult to complete. The vault of the temple will consist of a total of 44 layers and the work of the second layer has begun since this week. It is understood that this construction will be completed by the end of this year unless the construction of the vault will be completed after three to 4 times higher in all the structures and other resources until August, the construction work will be completed by the end of this year There is a big amount of stones being brought for the construction of the temple with the help of a jack Approximately 4 million concrete slab has to be used in the built temple Whereas till now 60,000 crates have also been. It is important that in the coming days, the operational organization is also in preparation to drop many times as much resources as possible. Aayodhya Nagri is a unique temple that represents the religious and cultural form of India, I hope that after the construction is complete, this temple will be counted as one of the biggest in the country.
